sn35.72:1.1: yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti,
sn35.72:1.2: avusitaṃ tena brahmacariyaṃ, ārakāva so imamhā dhammavinayāti.
sn35.72:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.72:2.3: ahañhi bhante channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti.
sn35.72:3.2: cakkhuṃ “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi na meso attā”ti samanupassasīti?
sn35.72:5.1: sādhu bhikkhu, ettha ca te bhikkhu cakkhuṃ “netaṃ mama neso hamasmi na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati.
sn35.72:5.2: evante etaṃ paṭhamaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāya …pe…
sn35.72:6.1: jivhaṃ “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi na meso attā”ti samanupassasīti?
sn35.72:8.1: sādhu bhikkhu, ettha ca te bhikkhu, jivhā “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā bhavissati. evante etaṃ catutthaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāya …pe…
sn35.72:9.1: manaṃ “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi na meso attā”ti samanupassasīti?
sn35.72:11.1: sādhu bhikkhu, ettha ca te bhikkhu, mano “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭho bhavissati.
sn35.72:11.2: evante etaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāyāti.
